question: Should ClawRouter support a non-Cloudflare production runtime, and what minimum feature parity must the first supported self-hosted target provide?
rationale: The repository currently treats Cloudflare services as correctness-bearing architecture, so this request changes the supported platform and long-term operational contract rather than adding packaging alone.

options.title: Design full portable runtime
options.body: Define adapters and conformance tests for all correctness-bearing services before adding a supported container target.

options.title: Offer limited evaluation mode
options.body: Provide a clearly labeled single-node container for evaluation while documenting that it lacks production parity.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare-only
options.body: Retain Cloudflare Workers as the sole supported production target and document Wrangler local mode as development-only.

recommendation.title: Design full portable runtime
recommendation.body: Define adapters and conformance tests for all correctness-bearing services before adding a supported container target.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent TypeScript data-plane, Cloudflare resource, storage, and deployment history is concentrated in his commits.
